-- ============================================================================
-- 🌌 SALCHIBLOX HUB | SPEED EDITION (V10.5 ULTIMATE MASTER SCRIPT + BYPASS)
-- Creator: SALCHIBLOX
-- Theme: Red & Black / Fully Customizable UI, Starfall, & Rain Colors
-- Features: Universal Anti-Cheat Bypass, 1-1000 Speed, Avatar Scaler (-100 to 100),
--          Crosshair, Spinbot, WalkOnWater, Chat Spy, Waypoints, FPS Booster, Anti-AFK,
--          UI Scale (25%-150%), Anti-Ragdoll / Anti-Bat, Instant Proximity Grab,
--          Working Colored Starfall & Rain Particle Emitters.
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- 0. UNIVERSAL ANTI-CHEAT BYPASS MODULE
-- ============================================================================
pcall(function()
    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    local oldIndex = mt.__index
    local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)

    -- Bypass property checks for WalkSpeed / JumpPower flags
    mt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, k)
        if not checkcaller() and (k == "WalkSpeed" or k == "JumpPower" or k == "HipHeight") then
            return 32
        end
        return oldIndex(self, k)
    end)

    setreadonly(mt, true)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or CoreGui

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. CONFIGURATION & CUSTOMIZATION DEFAULTS
-- ============================================================================
local Config = {
    HubName = "SALCHIBLOX HUB | SPEED EDITION",
    Creator = "SALCHIBLOX",
    TikTok = "https://www.tiktok.com/@prime_salchiblox",
    Discord = "https://discord.gg/UGSmvHdGX",
    
    -- Theme Colors
    AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 20, 60),
    SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28),
    BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 18),
    TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250),
    Transparency = 0.08,
    UIScale = 1, -- Default 100%
    
    AnnouncementsText = "Welcome to Salchiblox Hub V10.5 Master Edition! Anti-Cheat Bypass Active.",
    
    -- Movement & Avatar
    SpeedEnabled = false,
    SpeedValue = 32,
    SpeedMultiplier = 1,
    JumpEnabled = false,
    JumpValue = 50,
    AvatarSizeValue = 0,
    AvatarSizeEnabled = false,
    AntiSlideEnabled = true,
    AntiFlingEnabled = true,
    NoclipEnabled = false,
    FlyEnabled = false,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    InfJumpEnabled = false,
    BhopEnabled = false,
    WalkOnWaterEnabled = false,
    SpinbotEnabled = false,
    SpinbotSpeed = 25,
    
    -- Combat, ESP & Protection
    ESPEnabled = false,
    TracersEnabled = false,
    AimbotEnabled = false,
    HitboxEnabled = false,
    HitboxSize = 25,
    HitboxInf = false,
    AntiRagdollEnabled = true,
    InstantGrabEnabled = false,
    
    -- World & Visuals
    GravityEnabled = false,
    GravityValue = 196.2,
    FullbrightEnabled = false,
    FOVValue = 70,
    InfZoomEnabled = false,
    TimeOfDayValue = 14,
    TimeOfDayEnabled = false,
    FPSBoosterEnabled = false,
    
    -- Utilities & Fun
    AutoClickerEnabled = false,
    AutoClickerCPS = 10,
    InvisibleEnabled = false,
    AutoRespawnEnabled = false,
    ChatSpyEnabled = false,
    AntiAFKEnabled = true,
    PanicKey = Enum.KeyCode.P,
    
    -- Crosshair
    CrosshairEnabled = false,
    CrosshairSize = 10,
    
    -- Waypoints
    Waypoint1 = nil,
    Waypoint2 = nil,
    Waypoint3 = nil,
    
    -- Particles & Color Customization
    StarfallEnabled = false,
    StarfallCount = 75,
    StarfallSpeed = 40,
    StarfallColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    RainEnabled = false,
    RainAmount = 140,
    RainSpeed = 70,
    RainColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
}

-- Config System Functions (Max 5 Named Configs with Safe Local Storage File Handling)
local ConfigFolder = "SalchibloxHubConfigs"
pcall(function()
    if not isfolder(ConfigFolder) then
        makefolder(ConfigFolder)
    end
end)

local function getValidConfigName(name)
    local cleanName = name:gsub("[^%w_%-]", ""):sub(1, 20)
    if cleanName == "" then cleanName = "Config" end
    return cleanName
end

local function saveConfig(name)
    pcall(function()
        local safeName = getValidConfigName(name)
        local configsList = {}
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json") then
                configsList = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json"))
            end
        end)
        
        local found = false
        for _, cfgName in ipairs(configsList) do
            if cfgName == safeName then found = true break end
        end
        
        if not found then
            if #configsList >= 5 then
                table.remove(configsList, 1)
            end
            table.insert(configsList, safeName)
            writefile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(configsList))
        end
        
        local saveData = {
            UIScale = Config.UIScale,
            SpeedEnabled = Config.SpeedEnabled,
            SpeedValue = Config.SpeedValue,
            SpeedMultiplier = Config.SpeedMultiplier,
            JumpEnabled = Config.JumpEnabled,
            JumpValue = Config.JumpValue,
            AvatarSizeValue = Config.AvatarSizeValue,
            AvatarSizeEnabled = Config.AvatarSizeEnabled,
            AntiSlideEnabled = Config.AntiSlideEnabled,
            AntiFlingEnabled = Config.AntiFlingEnabled,
            NoclipEnabled = Config.NoclipEnabled,
            FlySpeed = Config.FlySpeed,
            InfJumpEnabled = Config.InfJumpEnabled,
            BhopEnabled = Config.BhopEnabled,
            WalkOnWaterEnabled = Config.WalkOnWaterEnabled,
            SpinbotEnabled = Config.SpinbotEnabled,
            SpinbotSpeed = Config.SpinbotSpeed,
            ESPEnabled = Config.ESPEnabled,
            AimbotEnabled = Config.AimbotEnabled,
            HitboxEnabled = Config.HitboxEnabled,
            HitboxSize = Config.HitboxSize,
            HitboxInf = Config.HitboxInf,
            AntiRagdollEnabled = Config.AntiRagdollEnabled,
            InstantGrabEnabled = Config.InstantGrabEnabled,
            GravityEnabled = Config.GravityEnabled,
            GravityValue = Config.GravityValue,
            FullbrightEnabled = Config.FullbrightEnabled,
            FOVValue = Config.FOVValue,
            InfZoomEnabled = Config.InfZoomEnabled,
            TimeOfDayValue = Config.TimeOfDayValue,
            TimeOfDayEnabled = Config.TimeOfDayEnabled,
            FPSBoosterEnabled = Config.FPSBoosterEnabled,
            AutoClickerEnabled = Config.AutoClickerEnabled,
            AutoClickerCPS = Config.AutoClickerCPS,
            ChatSpyEnabled = Config.ChatSpyEnabled,
            AntiAFKEnabled = Config.AntiAFKEnabled,
            StarfallEnabled = Config.StarfallEnabled,
            StarfallCount = Config.StarfallCount,
            StarfallColorR = Config.StarfallColor.R,
            StarfallColorG = Config.StarfallColor.G,
            StarfallColorB = Config.StarfallColor.B,
            RainEnabled = Config.RainEnabled,
            RainAmount = Config.RainAmount,
            RainColorR = Config.RainColor.R,
            RainColorG = Config.RainColor.G,
            RainColorB = Config.RainColor.B
        }
        
        writefile(ConfigFolder .. "/" .. safeName .. ".json", HttpService:JSONEncode(saveData))
    end)
end

local function loadConfig(name)
    pcall(function()
        local safeName = getValidConfigName(name)
        local filePath = ConfigFolder .. "/" .. safeName .. ".json"
        if isfile(filePath) then
            local fileContent = readfile(filePath)
            local loadedData = HttpService:JSONDecode(fileContent)
            for k, v in pairs(loadedData) do
                if k == "StarfallColorR" then
                    Config.StarfallColor = Color3.new(v, loadedData.StarfallColorG or 0, loadedData.StarfallColorB or 0)
                elseif k == "RainColorR" then
                    Config.RainColor = Color3.new(v, loadedData.RainColorG or 0, loadedData.RainColorB or 0)
                elseif Config[k] ~= nil then
                    Config[k] = v
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function getSavedConfigsList()
    local list = {}
    pcall(function()
        if isfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json") then
            list = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(ConfigFolder .. "/config_index.json"))
        end
    end)
    return list
end

-- Cleanup previous instances safely
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9") then
    PlayerGui.SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9:Destroy()
end
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9") then
    CoreGui.SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9:Destroy()
end

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. UI CREATION & WINDOW CONTROLS
-- ============================================================================
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SalchibloxHubSpeedEditionV9"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end

local UIHolderScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
UIHolderScale.Name = "SalchibloxUIScale"
UIHolderScale.Scale = Config.UIScale
UIHolderScale.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Main Window Frame
local MainWindow = Instance.new("Frame")
MainWindow.Name = "MainWindow"
MainWindow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 840, 0, 540)
MainWindow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -420, 0.5, -270)
MainWindow.BackgroundColor3 = Config.BackgroundColor
MainWindow.BackgroundTransparency = Config.Transparency
MainWindow.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainWindow.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

MainCorner.Parent = MainWindow

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Name = "MainStroke"
MainStroke.Color = Config.AccentColor

MainStroke.Thickness = 2.5
MainStroke.Parent = MainWindow

-- Floating Reopen Button
local ReopenButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ReopenButton.Name = "ReopenButton"
ReopenButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 50)
ReopenButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.05, 0)
ReopenButton.BackgroundColor3 = Config.BackgroundColor
ReopenButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
ReopenButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
ReopenButton.Visible = false
ReopenButton.Text = "🌌 SALCHIBLOX"
ReopenButton.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
ReopenButton.TextSize = 14
ReopenButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ReopenButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local ReopenCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ReopenCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
ReopenCorner.Parent = ReopenButton

local ReopenStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ReopenStroke.Name = "ReopenStroke"
ReopenStroke.Color = Config.AccentColor
ReopenStroke.Thickness = 2
ReopenStroke.Parent = ReopenButton

-- Top Bar / Title (Non-Draggable)
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Name = "TopBar"
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
TopBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBar.Parent = MainWindow

local TopBarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TopBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
TopBarCorner.Parent = TopBar

local TopBarFix = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBarFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
TopBarFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -14)
TopBarFix.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
TopBarFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBarFix.Parent = TopBar

local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Text = Config.HubName .. " | V10.5 MASTER + BYPASS"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
TitleLabel.TextSize = 15
TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar

local ControlsContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0)
ControlsContainer.Position = UDim2.new(1, -165, 0, 0)
ControlsContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ControlsContainer.Parent = TopBar

local function createTopButton(name, text, xPos, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, xPos, 0.5, -16)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = ControlsContainer
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    c.Parent = btn
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return btn
end

local ToggleMainHub
createTopButton("MiniBtn", "⚡", 0, function() end)
createTopButton("HideBtn", "H", 38, function() ToggleMainHub(false) end)
createTopButton("MinBtn", "-", 76, function() MainWindow.Visible = false; ReopenButton.Visible = true end)
createTopButton("CloseBtn", "X", 114, function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)

ReopenButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ToggleMainHub(true) end)

function ToggleMainHub(state)
    MainWindow.Visible = state
    ReopenButton.Visible = not state
end

-- ============================================================================
-- 3. LIVE ANNOUNCEMENT BANNER
-- ============================================================================
local AnnouncementBanner = Instance.new("Frame")
AnnouncementBanner.Name = "AnnouncementBanner"
AnnouncementBanner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
AnnouncementBanner.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 48)
AnnouncementBanner.BackgroundColor3 = Config.AccentColor
AnnouncementBanner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
AnnouncementBanner.BorderSizePixel = 0
AnnouncementBanner.Parent = MainWindow

local AnnounceText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
AnnounceText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
AnnounceText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
AnnounceText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
AnnounceText.Text = "📢 ANNOUNCEMENT: " .. Config.AnnouncementsText
AnnounceText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
AnnounceText.TextSize = 12
AnnounceText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
AnnounceText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
AnnounceText.Parent = AnnouncementBanner

-- ============================================================================
-- 4. STREAMLINED TAB NAVIGATION (6 ELITE WORKING TABS)
-- ============================================================================
local TabListContainer = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
TabListContainer.Name = "TabList"
TabListContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 195, 1, -92)
TabListContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 84)
TabListContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TabListContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
TabListContainer.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 450)
TabListContainer.ScrollBarThickness = 3
TabListContainer.Parent = MainWindow

local TabListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
TabListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
TabListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)

local ContentContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
ContentContainer.Name = "ContentContainer"
ContentContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -215, 1, -92)
ContentContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 84)
ContentContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentContainer.Parent = MainWindow

local Tabs = {}
local SectionHeaders = {}

local TabNames = {
    "Dashboard & Chat",
    "Movement & Fly",
    "Combat & ESP",
    "World & Visuals",
    "Teleports & Players",
    "Theme & Settings"
}

for _, name in ipairs(TabNames) do
    local tabContent = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    tabContent.Name = name:gsub(" & ", ""):gsub(" ", "") .. "Tab"
    tabContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    tabContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tabContent.BorderSizePixel = 0
    tabContent.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1600)
    tabContent.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    tabContent.Visible = false
    tabContent.Parent = ContentContainer
    
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
    layout.Parent = tabContent
    
    local tabButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    tabButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 44)
    tabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    tabButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    tabButton.Text = "   " .. name
    tabButton.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    tabButton.TextSize = 13
    tabButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    tabButton.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    tabButton.Parent = TabListContainer
    
    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    btnCorner.Parent = tabButton
    
    Tabs[name] = { Button = tabButton, Content = tabContent }
    
    tabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in pairs(Tabs) do
            t.Content.Visible = false
            t.Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
            t.Button.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
        end
        tabContent.Visible = true
        tabButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        tabButton.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    end)
end

-- Default tab
Tabs["Dashboard & Chat"].Content.Visible = true
Tabs["Dashboard & Chat"].Button.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
Tabs["Dashboard & Chat"].Button.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor

-- ============================================================================
-- UI BUILDER HELPERS
-- ============================================================================
local function createSectionHeader(parent, text)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 28)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = "   " .. text:upper()
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = parent
    table.insert(SectionHeaders, lbl)
    return lbl
end

local function createToggle(parent, text, defaultState, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 44)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 24)
    toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, -12)
    toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = defaultState and Config.AccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    toggleBtn.Text = ""
    toggleBtn.Parent = frame
    
    local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    tc.Parent = toggleBtn
    
    local circle = Instance.new("Frame")
    circle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
    circle.Position = defaultState and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
    circle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    circle.Parent = toggleBtn
    
    local cc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    cc.Parent = circle
    
    local state = defaultState
    toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Config.AccentColor or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
        circle.Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, -10) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -10)
        callback(state)
    end)
    return frame
end

local function createSlider(parent, text, min, max, defaultVal, callback)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 64)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
    frame.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    c.Parent = frame
    
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    stroke.Parent = frame
    
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 6)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Config.TextColor
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Parent = frame
    
    local valLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 28)
    valLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1, -85, 0, 6)
    valLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLbl.Text = tostring(defaultVal)
    valLbl.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    valLbl.TextSize = 13
    valLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    valLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    valLbl.Parent = frame
    
    local sliderBg = Instance.new("Frame")
    sliderBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 8)
    sliderBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 40)
    sliderBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
    sliderBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderBg.Parent = frame
    
    local sbgc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    sbgc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    sbgc.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp((defaultVal - min) / (max - min), 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = sliderBg
    
    local fc = Instance.new("UICorner")
    fc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    fc.Parent = fill
    
    local draggingSlider = false
    local function updateValue(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - sliderBg.AbsolutePosition.X) / sliderBg.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local val = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        valLbl.Text = tostring(val)
        callback(val)
    end
    
    sliderBg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = true
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            draggingSlider = false
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if draggingSlider and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateValue(input)
        end
    end)
    return frame
end

local function createButton(parent, text, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 42)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Config.SecondaryColor
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Config.AccentColor
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.Parent = parent
    
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")

            if targetSpeed > 300 then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 300
                if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (hum.MoveDirection * (targetSpeed - 300) * dt)
                end
            else
                hum.WalkSpeed = targetSpeed
            end
        else
            hum.WalkSpeed = 16
        end

        if Config.JumpEnabled then
            hum.JumpPower = Config.JumpValue
        end

        if Config.BhopEnabled then
            if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            end
        end

        if Config.SpinbotEnabled then
            hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Config.SpinbotSpeed), 0)
        end

            waterPlatform.Position = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = true
        else
            waterPlatform.CanCollide = false
        end

        if Config.NoclipEnabled then
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.HitboxEnabled then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

                    end
                    targetHrp.Transparency = 0.7
                    targetHrp.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end

        if Config.AimbotEnabled then
            local closestPlayer = nil
            local shortestDist = math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position - p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortestDist then
                        shortestDist = dist
                        closestPlayer = p
                    end
                end
            end
            if closestPlayer and closestPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, closestPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            end
        end

        if Config.StarfallEnabled then
            starfallEmitter.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
            starfallEmitter.Rate = Config.StarfallCount
            starfallEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.StarfallColor)
        else
            starfallEmitter.Rate = 0
        end

        if Config.RainEnabled then
            rainEmitter.Position = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0)
            rainEmitter.Rate = Config.RainAmount
            rainEmitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Config.RainColor)
        else
            rainEmitter.Rate = 0
        end
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local charModel = p.Character
            if Config.ESPEnabled then
                if not charModel:FindFirstChild("SalchibloxESPHighlight") then

    end
end)

local function GetAllEntities()
    local entities = {}
    local searchedContainers = {
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Entities"),
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Monsters"),
        Workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns"),
        Workspace
    }

    local function ScanContainer(container)
        if not container then return end
        for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Model") then
                if item:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or item:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or item:FindFirstChild("Head") then
                    if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(item) then
                        table.insert(entities, item)
                    end
                else
                    ScanContainer(item)
                end
            elseif item:IsA("Folder") then
                ScanContainer(item)
            elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name:lower():find("monster") then
                table.insert(entities, item)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, c in ipairs(searchedContainers) do
        if c then ScanContainer(c) end
    end

    local unique = {}
    local hash = {}
    for _, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        if not hash[ent] then
            hash[ent] = true
            table.insert(unique, ent)
        end
    end

    return unique
end

local function GetClosestScrap(hrp)
    local targetContainer = GetDebrisFolder()

    for _, item in ipairs(targetContainer:GetDescendants()) do
        local part = nil
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            part = item
        elseif item:IsA("Model") then
            part = item.PrimaryPart or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

        if part and item.Parent and part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            local dist = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < minDistance then
                minDistance = dist
                closest = {Item = item, Part = part}
            end
        end
    end
    return closest

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not ArrowToMonstersActive then 
        ClearArrows()
        return 
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not head or not cam then
        ClearArrows()
        return
    end

    local entities = GetAllEntities()
    local currentEntities = {}

    for idx, ent in ipairs(entities) do
        currentEntities[ent] = true
        local targetPart = ent:IsA("BasePart") and ent or (ent:IsA("Model") and (ent.PrimaryPart or ent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ent:FindFirstChild("Head") or ent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")))

        if targetPart then
            local arrowGui = ArrowCache[ent]
            if not arrowGui or not arrowGui.Parent then
                arrowGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                arrowGui.Name = "MonsterArrowGui"
                arrowGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                arrowGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
                arrowGui.Adornee = head
                arrowGui.Parent = MainGui

                local arrowImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                arrowImg.Name = "Arrow"
                arrowImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
                arrowImg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0.5, -12)
                arrowImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                arrowImg.Image = "rbxassetid://6034818372"
                arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                arrowImg.Parent = arrowGui

                local distLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                distLbl.Name = "Dist"
                distLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
                distLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -10)
                distLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                distLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                distLbl.TextSize = 9
                distLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                distLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
                distLbl.Parent = arrowGui

                ArrowCache[ent] = arrowGui
            end

            -- Alternates arrows on the sides of player head to avoid overlapping
            local isEven = (idx % 2 == 0)
            local sideMultiplier = isEven and 1 or -1
            local stackOffset = math.floor((idx - 1) / 2) * 1.2
            local xOffset = sideMultiplier * (2.2 + stackOffset)
            local yOffset = 1.5

            arrowGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(xOffset, yOffset, 0)

            -- ACCURATE POINT-AT-TARGET ROTATION MATH
            local targetPos = targetPart.Position
            local dist = math.floor((targetPos - head.Position).Magnitude)
            
            -- Compute angle using camera-relative coordinate space
            local localDir = cam.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(targetPos - cam.CFrame.Position)
            local angle = math.atan2(-localDir.X, -localDir.Z)

            local arrowImg = arrowGui:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
            local distLbl = arrowGui:FindFirstChild("Dist")

            if arrowImg then
                arrowImg.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
                if dist < 30 then
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
                elseif dist < 70 then
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 30)
                else
                    arrowImg.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
                end
            end

            if distLbl then
                distLbl.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
            end
        end
    end

    -- Clean up despawned entity arrows
    for ent, arrowGui in pairs(ArrowCache) do
        if not currentEntities[ent] or not ent.Parent then
            if arrowGui and arrowGui.Parent then arrowGui:Destroy() end
            ArrowCache[ent] = nil
        end
    end
end)

-- Kidnap Command & Control GUI Script (Fixed Throttling & Teleport Sequence)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local DEFAULT_MODEL_ID = 3544143040

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- F3X Endpoint Resolver
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function GetF3X()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local tool = (char and (char:FindFirstChild("Building Tools") or char:FindFirstChild("F3X"))) 
        or (backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Building Tools") or backpack:FindFirstChild("F3X")))
    
    if tool then
        local syncAPI = tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") or tool:FindFirstChild("SyncApi")
        if syncAPI then
            local endpoint = syncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") or syncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerControl")
            if endpoint then return endpoint end
        end
        for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") or desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return desc
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function MapPartType(part)
    if part:IsA("WedgePart") then return "Wedge" end
    if part:IsA("CornerWedgePart") then return "Corner" end
    if part:IsA("TrussPart") then return "Truss" end
    if part:IsA("Part") then
        if part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then return "Sphere" end
        if part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then return "Cylinder" end
    end
    return "Normal"
end

local function SafeGetObjects(id)
    local loaded = false
    local result = nil
    
    task.spawn(function()
        local success, raw = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)) end)
        if success and raw and #raw > 0 then
            result = raw[1]
        end
        loaded = true
    end)
    
    local timeWaited = 0
    while not loaded and timeWaited < 8 do
        task.wait(0.05)
        timeWaited += 0.05
    end
    
    return result
end

local function GetContainerBoundingBox(object)
    if object:IsA("Model") then
        local success, cf, size = pcall(function() return object:GetBoundingBox() end)
        if success and cf and size then
            return cf, size
        end
    elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
        return object.CFrame, object.Size
    end
    
    local parts = {}
    for _, desc in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, desc)
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        return CFrame.new(), Vector3.new(4, 1, 2)
    end
    
    local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
    local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
    
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        local cf = part.CFrame
        local size = part.Size
        local pmin = cf.Position - size/2
        local pmax = cf.Position + size/2
        minX = math.min(minX, pmin.X); minY = math.min(minY, pmin.Y); minZ = math.min(minZ, pmin.Z)
        maxX = math.max(maxX, pmax.X); maxY = math.max(maxY, pmax.Y); maxZ = math.max(maxZ, pmax.Z)
    end
    
    local center = Vector3.new((minX + maxX)/2, (minY + maxY)/2, (minZ + maxZ)/2)
    local size = Vector3.new(maxX - minX, maxY - minY, maxZ - minZ)
    return CFrame.new(center), size
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fast Parallel Asset Import
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function FastImportModel(endpoint, modelId, spawnCFrame)
    local rootObject = SafeGetObjects(modelId)
    if not rootObject then return nil, {}, {}, {} end

    local boundingCFrame = GetContainerBoundingBox(rootObject)
    local partsToImport = {}

    if rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(partsToImport, rootObject) end
    for _, child in ipairs(rootObject:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(partsToImport, child) end
    end

    if #partsToImport == 0 then
        rootObject:Destroy()
        return nil, {}, {}, {}
    end

    local createdF3XParts = {}
    local primaryPart = nil
    local doorParts = {}
    local createdMap = {}

    local pending = #partsToImport
    local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

    for idx, part in ipairs(partsToImport) do
        task.spawn(function()
            local targetCFrame = spawnCFrame * boundingCFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
            local partType = MapPartType(part)
            
            local ok, createdPart = pcall(function()
                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    return endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", partType, targetCFrame, workspace)
                else
                    endpoint:FireServer("CreatePart", partType, targetCFrame, workspace)
                end
            end)
            
            if ok and createdPart then
                createdMap[idx] = { Instance = createdPart, Original = part, TargetCFrame = targetCFrame }
            end

            pending -= 1
            if pending <= 0 then
                bindable:Fire()
            end
        end)
    end

    if pending > 0 then
        bindable.Event:Wait()
    end
    bindable:Destroy()

    local resizeBatch, colorBatch, matBatch, anchorBatch, collisionBatch = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local createMeshesBatch, syncMeshBatch = {}, {}

    for idx = 1, #partsToImport do
        if createdMap[idx] then
            local c = createdMap[idx].Instance
            local p = createdMap[idx].Original
            local t = createdMap[idx].TargetCFrame

            table.insert(createdF3XParts, c)
            if not primaryPart or p.Name == "Primary" or p.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or p.Name == "Body" then
                primaryPart = c
            end

            if string.find(string.lower(p.Name), "door") then
                table.insert(doorParts, c)
            end

            table.insert(resizeBatch, { Part = c, CFrame = t, Size = p.Size })
            table.insert(colorBatch, { Part = c, Color = p.Color })
            table.insert(matBatch, { Part = c, Material = p.Material, Transparency = p.Transparency })
            table.insert(anchorBatch, { Part = c, Anchored = true })
            table.insert(collisionBatch, { Part = c, CanCollide = false })

            if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
                table.insert(createMeshesBatch, { Part = c })
                table.insert(syncMeshBatch, {
                    Part = c,
                    MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh,
                    MeshId = p.MeshId,
                    TextureId = p.TextureID or "",
                    Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                })
            end

            for _, descendant in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                if descendant:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    table.insert(createMeshesBatch, { Part = c })
                    table.insert(syncMeshBatch, {
                        Part = c,
                        MeshType = descendant.MeshType,
                        MeshId = descendant.MeshId,
                        TextureId = descendant.TextureId,
                        Scale = descendant.Scale,
                        Offset = descendant.Offset,
                        VertexColor = descendant.VertexColor
                    })
                elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") or descendant:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    pcall(function()
                        local clone = descendant:Clone()
                        clone.Parent = c
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function SendBatch(method, batch)
        if #batch == 0 then return end
        local chunkSize = 200
        for i = 1, #batch, chunkSize do
            local chunk = {}
            for j = i, math.min(i + chunkSize - 1, #batch) do
                table.insert(chunk, batch[j])
            end
            pcall(function()
                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    endpoint:InvokeServer(method, chunk)
                else
                    endpoint:FireServer(method, chunk)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    SendBatch("SyncResize", resizeBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncColor", colorBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncAnchor", anchorBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncCollision", collisionBatch)
    if #createMeshesBatch > 0 then SendBatch("CreateMeshes", createMeshesBatch) end
    if #syncMeshBatch > 0 then SendBatch("SyncMesh", syncMeshBatch) end

    primaryPart = primaryPart or createdF3XParts[1]

    local partOffsets = {}
    if primaryPart then
        local primaryStartCF = primaryPart.CFrame
        for _, part in ipairs(createdF3XParts) do
            partOffsets[part] = primaryStartCF:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
        end
    end

    rootObject:Destroy()
    return primaryPart, createdF3XParts, partOffsets, doorParts
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Target Resolver (Prefix / First-Letter Match)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getTargets(arg)
    if not arg or arg == "" then return {LocalPlayer} end
    arg = string.lower(arg)

    if arg == "me" then
        return {LocalPlayer}
    elseif arg == "all" then
        return Players:GetPlayers()
    elseif arg == "others" then
        local matched = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(matched, p) end
        end
        return matched
    end

    local matched = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = string.lower(p.Name)
        local disp = string.lower(p.DisplayName)
        
        if string.sub(name, 1, #arg) == arg or string.sub(disp, 1, #arg) == arg or string.find(name, arg, 1, true) or string.find(disp, arg, 1, true) then
            table.insert(matched, p)
        end
    end
    return matched
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core Kidnap Execution
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function executeKidnap(targetPlayer, modelId, driveDistance, moveSpeed)
    task.spawn(function()
        local endpoint = GetF3X()
        if not endpoint then
            warn("Kidnap Error: F3X Building Tools not found!")
            return
        end

        local char = targetPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end

        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isLocal = (targetPlayer == LocalPlayer)

        if torso and humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
            humanoid.JumpPower = 0
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false

            local tPos = torso.CFrame
            local approachDist = math.clamp(driveDistance * 0.4, 200, 1000)
            local spawnPos = tPos * (CFrame.new(-approachDist, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            local primary, allParts, offsets, doorParts = FastImportModel(endpoint, modelId, spawnPos)
            if not primary or #allParts == 0 then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                return
            end

            local function check()
                return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players and torso and humanoid and torso.Parent and humanoid.Parent and char and char.Parent
            end

            local sound, chuckle
            if isLocal then
                sound = Instance.new("Sound", primary)
                sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://532147820"
                sound.Looped = true
                sound:Play()

                chuckle = Instance.new("Sound", primary)
                chuckle.SoundId = "rbxassetid://109527445730513"
                chuckle.Looped = true
                chuckle.Volume = 0.25
                chuckle:Play()
            end

            local function SetDoorTransparency(transparencyValue)
                if #doorParts > 0 then
                    local matBatch = {}
                    for _, dPart in ipairs(doorParts) do
                        table.insert(matBatch, { Part = dPart, Material = dPart.Material, Transparency = transparencyValue })
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
                        else
                            endpoint:FireServer("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            -- Throttled Drive Loop (20Hz Server Network Update Rate)
            local function SmoothThrottledDrive(startCF, targetCF, speed)
                local dist = (targetCF.Position - startCF.Position).Magnitude
                local duration = math.max(0.2, dist / speed)
                local startTime = os.clock()
                local lastNetworkSend = 0
                local sendInterval = 0.05 -- 20 FPS network sync rate to prevent server throttling
                local thread = coroutine.running()
                local conn

                conn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                    if not check() then
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        task.spawn(thread)
                        return
                    end

                    local now = os.clock()
                    local elapsed = now - startTime
                    local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
                    local currentCF = startCF:Lerp(targetCF, alpha)

                    -- Update server positions at 20Hz interval
                    if (now - lastNetworkSend) >= sendInterval or alpha >= 1 then
                        lastNetworkSend = now
                        local batchMove = {}
                        for part, offsetCF in pairs(offsets) do
                            table.insert(batchMove, { Part = part, CFrame = currentCF * offsetCF })
                        end

                        task.spawn(function()
                            pcall(function()
                                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                    endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMove", batchMove)
                                else
                                    endpoint:FireServer("SyncMove", batchMove)
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end

                    if alpha >= 1 then
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        task.spawn(thread)
                    end
                end)

                coroutine.yield()
            end

            -- Drive Approach Phase
            local approachStartCF = spawnPos
            local approachTargetCF = tPos * (CFrame.new(0, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            SmoothThrottledDrive(approachStartCF, approachTargetCF, moveSpeed)

            if sound then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 end
            task.wait(0.1)
            if check() then SetDoorTransparency(1) end
            task.wait(0.2)

            -- Lock Player Inside Vehicle
            local activeWeld = nil
            local lockConnection = nil

            if check() then
                local vehicleInsideCF = primary.CFrame * (CFrame.new(0, 2.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
                
                if isLocal then
                    torso.Anchored = true
                    torso.CFrame = vehicleInsideCF

                    lockConnection = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                        if check() and primary and primary.Parent then
                            torso.CFrame = primary.CFrame * (CFrame.new(0, 2.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {{ Part = torso, Anchored = false }})
                                endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateWelds", { primary }, torso)
                            else
                                endpoint:FireServer("SyncAnchor", {{ Part = torso, Anchored = false }})
                                endpoint:FireServer("CreateWelds", { primary }, torso)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    torso.CFrame = vehicleInsideCF
                    activeWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    activeWeld.Part0 = primary
                    activeWeld.Part1 = torso
                    activeWeld.Parent = primary
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.2)
            if check() then SetDoorTransparency(0) end
            task.wait(0.2)

            if sound then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.3 end

            -- Drive Away Phase
            local driveAwayStartCF = approachTargetCF
            local driveAwayTargetCF = tPos * (CFrame.new(driveDistance, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            SmoothThrottledDrive(driveAwayStartCF, driveAwayTargetCF, moveSpeed)

            if isLocal and targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
                pcall(function()
                    TeleportService:Teleport(131190128172062, targetPlayer)
                end)
            end

            task.wait(0.2)

            if lockConnection then lockConnection:Disconnect() end
            if isLocal and torso then torso.Anchored = false end
            if activeWeld then pcall(function() activeWeld:Destroy() end) end

            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                        endpoint:InvokeServer("Remove", allParts)
                    else
                        endpoint:FireServer("Remove", allParts)
                    end
                end)
            end)

            pcall(function()
                if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                        humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                        humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local difference = hrp.Position - targetHRP.Position

                if difference.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local vec = difference.Unit
                    local dot = math.clamp(targetLook:Dot(vec), -1, 1)
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(dot))

                    if angle <= maxAngle then
                        local dist = difference.Magnitude

                        if dist < closestDist then
                            closestDist = dist
                            closest = hrp
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

    local function updateDrag(input)
        if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPosition then
            return
        end

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then
            return
        end

        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

        local newX = startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local newY = startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

        newX = math.clamp(
            newX,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
        )

        newY = math.clamp(
            newY,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        )

        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
    end

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            local target = input.Target

            if target == closeBtn
                or target == guiToggle
                or target == targetBox
                or target == standBtn
                or target == punchBtn
                or target == posBox
                or target == offBox
                or target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    dragInput = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput then
            updateDrag(input)
        end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if standOn and bp and gyro and targetBox.Text ~= "" then

        if vanished and savedCharacterCFrame then
            bp.Position = Vector3.new(
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.Z
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                bp.Position,
                bp.Position + savedCharacterCFrame.LookVector
            )

            return
        end

        floatTime += dt * 2
        local floatOffset = math.sin(floatTime) * 0.5

        local t = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetHRP = t.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local tcf = targetHRP.CFrame
            local desiredPos

            if blocking then
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    + tcf.LookVector * BLOCK_DISTANCE
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
            else
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    - tcf.LookVector * standDistance
                    + tcf.RightVector * sideOffset
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset + floatOffset, 0)
            end

            bp.Position = bp.Position:Lerp(
                desiredPos,
                math.clamp(followSpeed, 0.01, 1)
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + tcf.LookVector
            )
        end
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- FLING
-- ============================================================

local function runPastebinStyleFling(duration)
    local start = tick()
    local movel = 0.1

    while tick() - start < duration do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000
                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel
                + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- MUDA MUDA ATTACK
-- ============================================================

local function punchTarget()
    local punchAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    punchAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://86464152593138"

    local punchTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(punchAnim)
    punchTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    punchTrack:Play()

    task.delay(1, function()
        if punchTrack then
            punchTrack:Stop()
            punchTrack:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    local targetPlayer = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

    if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then
        return
    end

    local targetHRP =
        targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not targetHRP then
        return
    end

    SendChatMessage("MUDA! MUDA! MUDA! MUDA! MUDA!")

    local nearest = GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer)

    if not nearest then
        return
    end

    local wasStandOn = standOn

    if wasStandOn then
        standOn = false
        standBtn.Text = "「 THE WORLD: OFF 」"
        disableStand()
    end

    humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(nearest.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))

    local tempBP = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
    tempBP.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    tempBP.P = 4000
    tempBP.D = 100
    tempBP.Position = nearest.Position
    tempBP.Parent = humanoidRootPart

    local tempGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    tempGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
    tempGyro.P = 4000
    tempGyro.D = 100
    tempGyro.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
    tempGyro.Parent = humanoidRootPart

    local followConnection

    followConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not (
            tempBP
            and tempGyro
            and nearest
            and nearest.Parent
        ) then
            return
        end

        tempBP.Position = nearest.Position

        local lookVec = nearest.CFrame.LookVector

        tempGyro.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + lookVec
            )
    end)

    task.delay(followDuration, function()
        if followConnection then
            followConnection:Disconnect()
            followConnection = nil
        end

        if tempBP then
            tempBP:Destroy()
            tempBP = nil
        end

        if tempGyro then
            tempGyro:Destroy()
            tempGyro = nil
        end
    end)

    local effect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    effect.Saturation = -1
    effect.Parent = game.Lighting

    local s = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
    s.SoundId = punchSoundId
    s.Volume = 1
    s:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(s, 3)

    task.delay(0.2, function()
        local s2 = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
        s2.SoundId = heavyPunchSoundId
        s2.Volume = 1
        s2:Play()
        Debris:AddItem(s2, 3)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        runPastebinStyleFling(flingDuration)
    end)

    task.delay(flingDuration + 0.25, function()
        if followConnection then
            followConnection:Disconnect()
            followConnection = nil
        end

        if tempBP then
            tempBP:Destroy()
            tempBP = nil
        end

        if tempGyro then
            tempGyro:Destroy()
            tempGyro = nil
        end

        if effect and effect.Parent then
            effect:Destroy()
        end

        if wasStandOn then
            standOn = true
            standBtn.Text = "「 THE WORLD: ON 」"
            enableStand()

            if bp then
                bp.Position = humanoidRootPart.Position
            end
        end
    end)
end

punchBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(punchTarget)

-- ============================================================
-- CHAT COMMANDS
-- ============================================================

local function onPlayerChatted(otherPlayer, message)
    local targetName = targetBox.Text

    if not targetName or targetName == "" then
        return
    end

    local lowerMessage = message:lower()

    local targetMatches =
        otherPlayer.Name:lower():find(targetName:lower())

    if not targetMatches then
        return
    end

    if standOn and lowerMessage:find("barrage") then
        punchTarget()
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("block")
        and standOn
        and not vanished
        and not blocking then

        blocking = true
        SendChatMessage("THE WORLD: BLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("unblock")
        and standOn
        and blocking then

        blocking = false
        SendChatMessage("THE WORLD: UNBLOCK")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("vanish")
        and standOn
        and not vanished then

        vanished = true

        savedCharacterCFrame =
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject

        humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
            CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
            )

        local target =
            findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if target and target.Character then
            local targetHumanoid =
                target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if targetHumanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = targetHumanoid
            end
        end

        SendChatMessage("THE WORLD!")
        return
    end

    if lowerMessage:find("summon") then

        if blocking then
            blocking = false
        end

        if vanished then
            vanished = false

            if savedCharacterCFrame
                and humanoidRootPart
                and humanoidRootPart.Parent then

                humanoidRootPart.CFrame =
                    savedCharacterCFrame
            end

            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if humanoid then
                camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
            elseif savedCameraSubject then
                camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            end

            savedCharacterCFrame = nil
            savedCameraSubject = nil

            SendChatMessage("ZA WARUDO! TOKI WO TOMARE!")
            return
        end

        standOn = not standOn

        standBtn.Text =
            standOn
            and "「 THE WORLD: ON 」"
            or "「 THE WORLD: OFF 」"

        if standOn then
            enableStand()

            local t =
                findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

            if t
                and t.Character
                and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

                for _, id in ipairs(summonSoundIds) do
                    local summon =
                        Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)

                    summon.SoundId = id
                    summon.Volume = 1
                    summon:Play()

                    Debris:AddItem(summon, 3)
                end
            end

            SendChatMessage("ZA WARUDO! TOKI WO TOMARE!")
        else
            disableStand()
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- PLAYER CHAT CONNECTIONS
-- ============================================================

for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= player then
        p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
            onPlayerChatted(p, msg)
        end)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    if p ~= player then
        p.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
            onPlayerChatted(p, msg)
        end)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    character = char

    humanoidRootPart =
        character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    humanoid =
        character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    if vanished then
        vanished = false
        savedCharacterCFrame = nil
        savedCameraSubject = nil

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
    end

    disableStand()

    standOn = false
    blocking = false

    standBtn.Text = "「 THE WORLD: OFF 」"
end)

-- ============================================================
-- THE WORLD LEVITATION / MOVEMENT ANIMATIONS
-- ============================================================

local levitateIdle = Instance.new("Animation")
levitateIdle.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://122746752555782"

local moveAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
moveAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://10921135644"

local levitateTrack
local moveTrack

local function playLevitateIdle()
    if humanoid and not levitateTrack then
        levitateTrack =
            humanoid:LoadAnimation(levitateIdle)

        levitateTrack.Priority =
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle

        levitateTrack.Looped = true
        levitateTrack:Play()
    end
end

local function stopLevitateIdle()
    if levitateTrack then
        levitateTrack:Stop()
        levitateTrack:Destroy()
        levitateTrack = nil
    end
end

local function playMoveAnim()
    if humanoid and not moveTrack then
        moveTrack =
            humanoid:LoadAnimation(moveAnim)

        moveTrack.Priority =
            Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

        moveTrack.Looped = true
        moveTrack:Play()
    end
end

local function stopMoveAnim()
    if moveTrack then
        moveTrack:Stop()
        moveTrack:Destroy()
        moveTrack = nil
    end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if standOn then
        local target =
            findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if target
            and target.Character
            and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

            local targetHumanoid =
                target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if targetHumanoid then
                if targetHumanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    stopLevitateIdle()
                    playMoveAnim()
                else
                    stopMoveAnim()
                    playLevitateIdle()
                end
            end
        else
            stopMoveAnim()
            playLevitateIdle()
        end
    else
        stopLevitateIdle()
        stopMoveAnim()
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- NOCLIP
-- ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclip = false

local function setNoclip(enabled)
    noclip = enabled
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
        setNoclip(not noclip)
        print("The World Noclip:", noclip and "ON" or "OFF")
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not noclip then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CanCollide = false
        end
    end
end)

Type these commands in chat:

* `SUMMON` — Returns your character to its original position after using `VANISH`.
* `BARRAGE` — Performs the **MUDA MUDA!** barrage attack.
* `BLOCK` — Moves The World in front of the target.
* `UNBLOCK` — Stops blocking.

* **Offset** — Moves The World left/right.

* **GUI** — Hides/shows the controller.
